Preconditions: Admin is authenticated
Steps: Open Category Management; create category with valid name; save; observe list
ExpectedResult: Category is created and appears in category list with the entered name

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated
Steps: Attempt to create category with empty name
ExpectedResult: Category is rejected; no new category is created

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated
Steps: Attempt to create category with whitespace-only name
ExpectedResult: Category is rejected after trimming; no new category is created

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; API execution is allowed
Steps: Send category create request without name field
ExpectedResult: Category is rejected; no new category is created

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated
Steps: Create category with script-looking name; view category list
ExpectedResult: Script-looking name is rejected or displayed as text; no script is executed

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; category with same name already exists

ExpectedResult: System handles duplicate name consistently without corrupting category list; if duplicates are not allowed, clear validation feedback is shown

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated
Steps: Create category with a very long ASCII name; observe list

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; category was already deleted; API execution is allowed
Steps: Attempt to delete the same category again

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; API execution is allowed
Steps: Attempt to delete category with malformed ID

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated; category referenced by at least one product exists

Preconditions: Admin is authenticated
